sources.title: The Successive Approximation Approach for NUM Frameworks with Elastic and Inelastic Traffic
sources.snippet: The concave utility in the Network Utility Maximization (NUM) problem is only suitable for elastic flows. However, the networks with the multiclass traffic, the utility of inelastic traffic is usually represented by the sigmoidal function which is a nonconcave function. Hence, the basic NUM problem becomes a nonconvex optimization problem. Solving the nonconvex NUM distributively is a difficult problem.
